page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. At the top: running head centred, page number at top right. Below that, two round medallion portraits side by side, with their legends printed around them. Under them, one column of text in two paragraphs, starting with capitalised lead-in words.

main_text.l: D. SAB. PHILIBERTVS
MARGARETA MAX. FIL.
PHILIBERTVS Sabaudiæ Dux octauus, succedit pa-
tri Philippo anno mundi 5457. à Christo nato 1495. Hic pie-
tatem summopere coluit, magnanimus, speciosissimus, atque
omnibus acceptissimus fuit, pulcher etiam ob elegantiâ cogno-
minatus. Margaretâ coniugem accepit, quam ex Maria Caroli
Burgūdię Ducis filia susceperat Maximilianus, obiit multa co-
mmendatione dignus, nullis interim relictis liberis: quare ei Ca-
rolus frater successit. Vide Allobrogum, siue Sabaudiæ Chro.*
MARGARETA Imperatoris Maximiliani filia, ut di-
ctum est, ac Philiberti supradicti relicta, animum pudicũ atque
amorem erga virum castissimum testata est, tum quòd nullum
superinduxerit coniugem, vitâ perpetuò cælibem ac laudatissi-
mam ducés:tum quòd in urbe quam vulgo Burgum in Bressia
vocât, templũ nobile ac celebratissimum extruxerit, quod in-
ter Europæ nuper structa ædificia, tanquâ opus rarum ac perce-
lebre prædicatur: nec id quidem ob templi amplitudinem, sed
potius ob artis ornamenta ac splendorem, ut omnium conspi-
cientium oculos in admirationem trahat. Verùm ædificij de-
cus ac splendorem longè superat sepulchrũ candidissimo mar-
more extructum: ubi extat amantissimi coniugis effigies ad vi-
vum expressa: in quod signum quicquid ars sculpendi unquam
valuit, contulisse, ac deprompsisse videtur: hæc Ducis effigies
hinc & inde habet duarum Margaretarum marmorea simula-
chra ad vivum etiam formata: nempe Margaretæ uxoris prædictæ,
& Margaretæ alterius, quæ Ducis mater extitit. Vide ut
supra.

page.notes: Two round medallion portraits (engravings) at the top: left, a man in a flat cap, legend "D. SAB." and "PHILIBERTVS"; right, a veiled woman with a flower, legend "MARGARETA" and "MAX. FIL.". The legends are transcribed above as printed lines. The "*" after "Chro." and the ornament after "celebratissimum" are printed signs, copied as seen; the ornament is not reproduced exactly. Some letters in "ducés:tum" and "Burgūdię" are small and may be misread. "Vide ut supra" is printed in the last line.
